newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Star Ent continues up after cash call plan.
newsitem.headline: Star Ent continues up after cash call plan.

text.p: Shares of Star Entertainment (International Holdings) Ltd continued to surge on Wednesday ahead of a proposed rights issue, brokers said.
"Market makers are boosting the price to make the issue more attractive," one sales manager at a regional brokerage said.
Star Entertainment has proposed a rights issue on the basis of eight rights shares for one existing share.
The shares gained HK$0.30 or 55.56 percent over the last two trading days. They rose a further HK$0.14 on Wednesday to a morning high of HK$0.98, before closing the morning at HK$0.91.
Volume was 20.83 million shares worth HK$19.43 million.
Brokers said possible asset injections after the cash call and the use of proceeds for business expansion would also be positive for the company.
But they said a pullback could be in store for the shares.

"Despite the shares' firm tone ahead of the book closing date for the rights issue (from October 10-16), a correction is expected in the immediate run after the recent rally," an analyst at a local brokerage said.

Star Entertainment said on Monday that proceeds of the issue would be used to finance film production, to secure distribution rights, to finance or purchase rights to distribute television drama series and to build a video library.
